instrument: 16 TAC § 25.194, large load interconnection standards (PUCT Project No. 58481), adopted Sept 18, 2026
summary: Adopted Sept 18, 2026, effective Oct 8, 2026: interconnection standards for loads of 75 MW or more at a single site in ERCOT. The final rule dropped the proposed non-refundable interconnection fee, keeping a flat study fee of $100,000 and requiring financial security of $50,000 per MW before interconnection studies.

source.citation: White & Case client alert (Sept 2026); Utility Dive (Sept 2026); interconnection.fyi

notes: Final SB 6 large-load rule targeted for December 31, 2026. Stated purpose includes reducing duplicate and never-built queue requests SUPERSEDES the March 12, 2026 draft ($50,000/MW security deposit and fee). Threshold wording: the rule is reported as "equal to or exceeding" 75 MW; SB 6 (Util. Code 37.0561(c)) says total load at a single site would "exceed" 75 MW.
confidence_note: Adopted rule text and order not read. Security is reported as refundable; the proposed non-refundable fee was eliminated.

next.event: Texas PUC large-load interconnection rule (16 TAC § 25.194) takes effect
